parole.significato: Of or pertaining to the Nambé people or the variety of Tewa they speak.
parole.testo: From Spanish Nambé, from Tewa Nąnbeʼ (“rounded earth”).

parole.significato: A member of the Navajo people, currently the largest Native American tribe in North America.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Spanish navajo, from Tewa navahúuˀu (“field adjoining an arroyo”).

parole.significato: Of or pertaining to the Pojoaque people.
parole.testo: From Spanish Pojoaque, from Tewa Pʼohsu̧wä̧geh (“water drinking place”).

parole.significato: Of or pertaining to the Tesuque people.
parole.testo: From Spanish Tesuque, from Tewa Teˀtsʼúgéh (“narrow place of the cottonwood trees”).

parole.significato: Of or pertaining to the Tewa Pueblo people, culture, or language.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Spanish Tegua, Tehua, from Tewa Téwa or Hopi Teewa.
